annotations.text:
Four home directions, same data. Differences are information architecture, not color.
A: points scoreboard hero, tabs underneath. B: the night as a feed, points pinned on top. C: everything at once as cards. D: sports-app matchup card, tap a row to drill in.
Below: Week 1 and Game 2 screens with breadcrumbs, shared by all four.
Opponent scores and points for Week 1 are SAMPLE (Here 4 Beer's last-season numbers). Our four bowlers' scores are real.
